linear_attention.input.equation: X := normalized KDA input hidden states [B,T,H]

linear_attention.qk_l2_norm.equation: Q = Q / L2Norm(Q); K = K / L2Norm(K); V is unchanged

linear_attention.recurrent_state.equation: recurrent_state_next := S_t written by recurrent_update; recurrent_state_read := S_(t-1)

linear_attention.recurrent_update.equation: S_t = exp(log_decay_t) elementwise_mul S_(t-1) + beta_t * k_t outer (v_t - S_(t-1)^T * k_t)
invariants: beta has shape [B,T,N] and broadcasts over Dkda

dsa_attention.input.equation: X := normalized DSA input hidden states [B,T,H]

dsa_attention.key_pool_compression.equation: K_pool[p] = sum_j(pool_gate[p,j] * K_index[p,j]) + pool_position[p] for j in a P-token pool

dsa_attention.sparse_mla_core.equation: C = Softmax(Gather(Q_nope * K_nope^T, token_ids) / sqrt(Dqk)) * Gather(V, token_ids)

dense_mlp.clamped_swiglu.equation: M = SiLU(Clamp(G, max=limit)) elementwise_mul Clamp(U, min=-limit, max=limit)

moe.topk.equation: expert_ids = TopK(selection_score, K); weights = Normalize(Gather(p, expert_ids)) * routed_scale
